evidence.text:
func TestWaitForDurability(t *testing.T) {
	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, nil)
	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(0))
	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch(nil))
	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{}))

	b := d.NewBatch()
	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), nil))
	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("b"), []byte("2"), nil))
	require.NoError(t, d.Apply(b, Sync))
	seqNum := b.SeqNum()
	require.NoError(t, b.Close())

	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(seqNum))
	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(seqNum+1))
	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{seqNum, seqNum + 1}))

	high, err := d.DurableState()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.GreaterOrEqual(t, high, seqNum+2)
}
WaitForDurability / WaitForDurabilityContext - block until a sequence number is durable; zero succeeds after any commit.
DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) - highest durable sequence number and first latched error.

original_test_observation_census.scope: All repository-origin *_test.go files in frozen corpus; separately rg of current source repository returned the same single call.

findings.reason: Batch.SeqNum is the first record sequence number. The complete source test performs exactly two Set records in its only Sync commit. Their sequence numbers are s and s+1. The test nevertheless requires DurableState high >= s+2, beyond the greatest record it committed. The source fixture creates an isolated in-memory filesystem and no other writer.

Waiting for the same open, error-free database highest durable sequence number follows the public meaning of the two APIs. Adding this call does not repair the original high >= s+2 assertion. Candidate generation preserves that assertion, so the full candidate cannot count as a verified valid witness.

The current implementation stores start+count as highestDurableSeqNum, then accepts seqNum <= highestDurableSeqNum. Thus returning this value and waiting for it can agree while both reflect the same incorrect inclusive boundary. A consistency relation cannot by itself establish the independently specified boundary.

Only TestWaitForDurability invokes DurableState in original tests. The current uniform generator has no second source observation to select. No source oracle was removed, corrected, or replaced after this audit.
